view: PA (frontal), L marker at image upper right confirming conventional orientation
technical_quality: Suboptimal: patient rotated (medial clavicle ends asymmetric, mediastinum appears shifted toward the left), shallow inspiration with hypoinflated lungs, lower film includes much of the upper abdomen; penetration adequate (thoracic spine visible through the heart); both costophrenic angles included.

devices.location: Image upper right corner, over the patient's left shoulder region (outside the thorax)

abnormalities.finding: Hazy, ill-defined increased perihilar and medial basal opacity with accentuated bronchovascular markings, consistent with a patchy infiltrate (possible dataset target); not well marginated, borders indistinct
Subtle retrocardiac haziness in the left lower zone behind the heart, partly attributable to rotation and hypoinflation; cannot exclude a second area of infiltrate
Cardiac silhouette appears enlarged (estimated CTR about 0.55-0.6) with rounded apex; likely exaggerated by rotation and shallow inspiration, so true cardiomegaly is uncertain
Mild thoracic scoliosis / spinal curvature; mediastinum and trachea appear displaced toward the left, most likely positional (rotation) rather than true shift
Elevated right hemidiaphragm relative to the left (right dome higher than expected), with prominent gastric/bowel gas under the left hemidiaphragm

description_zh: 胸部正面 X 光片，病人有明顯旋轉且吸氣不足，影像品質受限。右側肺門周圍至右下肺野內側可見模糊、邊界不清的浸潤性增加密度影，支氣管血管紋理增粗，範圍約 6–8 公分；左下肺野心後區亦有輕微模糊影，部分可能與旋轉及低通氣有關，無法完全排除第二處浸潤。心影偏大（心胸比約 0.55–0.6），但受旋轉及吸氣不足影響，真實心臟擴大程度不確定；縱膈與氣管略向左偏，右側橫膈較左側抬高，左橫膈下可見胃泡及腸氣。未見肋膜積液、氣胸、胸管、中心靜脈導管、心律調節器或其他體內裝置，僅於影像右上角見外部「L」標記。
